svg.title: Complete TS2Vec architecture
svg.desc: Full pipeline: input batch, two overlapping crops, shared linear projection, independent Bernoulli masking, one dilated CNN encoder with residual blocks shown in detail, overlap representations, hierarchical dual contrastive loss with temporal and instance contrast, gradient feedback, and the inference path producing per timestamp representations consumed by classification, forecasting and anomaly detection.

g.text: B x T x C, unlabeled, NaN ok

svg.text: 4. Encoder: one network, called on A then on B
10 residual blocks, kernel 3, non causal, same padding
Channels: 64 hidden, 320 out. Receptive field about 2047 samples
Sees both past and future context of every timestamp
Dot products, softmax, then minus log p(positive)
Sum both halves, then max pool time by 2 and repeat
until T = 1, average over all levels
After training: inference, no crops, no masks

g.text: Max pool all t, then SVM

svg.text: Training loop: steps 1 to 6 repeat with fresh random crops and masks every step
